**Answer:**

| Laureate | Award year | UK affiliation at award | RePEc “Articles” before award | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **John R. Hicks** | 1972 | University of Oxford | 41 articles (all before 1972) | [ideas.repec.org/e/c/phi7.html](https://ideas.repec.org/e/c/phi7.html) |

**Conclusion**  
There is no UK‑born Nobel laureate in Economic Sciences, affiliated with a UK institution at the time of their award before 2009, who has fewer than 20 pre‑award “Articles” on ideas.repec.org.
